scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Urban Local Body In Providing Services And Facilities To Senior Citizens
other_conditions: Nominee must be a municipal body, cantonment board, or other statutory urban local body.
Nominee must have exemplary contribution in health, counselling, legal aid, awareness, institutional and non‑institutional programmes for the elderly.
Nominee must have played a significant role in empowerment of elder people at the village level.
Nominee must have achieved outstanding community participation in promoting care for the elderly.
Nominee must have promoted a barrier‑free environment in public buildings within the municipality area.
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized agency; self‑nominations are not considered.
The award is open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed.
benefits_summary: The award includes a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹5,00,000, with travel, lodging and allowance expenses for the awardee and one companion covered by the Government.
